ZBrush is professional digital sculpting, painting, and modelling software for character and creature artists, digital sculptors, and concept artists. It lets you shape highly detailed 3D models the way you would work with real clay, with a brush system that can handle tens of millions of polygons in real time. From film and games to toys, collectibles, jewellery, and product design, ZBrush is where form takes shape. Sculpt with total freedom, refine to micro detail, then hand off clean geometry to your animation, rendering, and manufacturing pipelines.

ZBrush is built for character and creature artists, digital sculptors, and concept artists, from professionals in production to artists investing in long-term skill growth. Illustrators and designers new to 3D often start on iPad and move to desktop.

Every ZBrush subscription includes ZBrush on desktop, iPad, and Windows on Arm devices with premium features, rendering with Redshift, ZBrush Classroom, and Cineversity training. Maxon One adds Cinema 4D, Red Giant, Universe, and Capsules.

ZBrush works between desktop, iPad, and Windows on Arm devices, so creators can maintain seamless workflow continuity across devices. We aim to deliver consistent features while optimizing the sculpting experience for each device. Check our ZBrush Feature Comparison page to see which version suits you best.
ZBrush is compatible with most of the latest versions of Windows (including Windows on Arm (WoA)), macOS, and iPadOS. For detailed information, check out our list of system requirements .

ZBrush is built around true sculptural control and artistic mastery, with the depth to take work from first idea to final production. It rewards skill and scales from exploration to production, rather than replacing the artist.
ZBrush imports and exports standard 3D geometry formats and most industry-standard image formats for texturing, and connects to other applications through GoZ.
ZBrush runs on Windows (including Windows on Arm), macOS, and iPadOS. Its processor-based engine runs well on most modern machines. A graphics tablet is strongly recommended.

As the industry standard for digital sculpting, you can find works created with ZBrush across the entertainment industry. It’s been used to create characters and props in such beloved film franchises as Star Wars, Lord of the Rings, The Marvel Cinematic Universe, Transformers, Dune, and many more. In AAA video games, ZBrush has been used for Fortnite, God of War, Assassin’s Creed, and The Last of Us, among many others. ZBrush has also been used to create realistic figurines in popular tabletop games like Warhammer.

ZBrush is compatible with most of the latest versions of Windows (including Windows on Arm (WoA)), macOS, and iPadOS. ZBrush licensing is dual platform, so you can run on desktop and iPad simultaneously or switch between them at any time. Thanks to its processor-based engine, ZBrush runs well on most modern computers regardless of their graphics cards. A graphic tablet (such as from Wacom) is strongly recommended. It will give you more control and easier interaction. Support now extends to include Apple M-series Silicon Graphics chip processing. Take advantage of the latest technology while working inside the world’s most powerful digital sculpting software. ZBrush is available in English, German, Spanish, Korean, Chinese, French, Japanese, and Brazilian Portuguese.

ZBrush is professional digital sculpting, painting, and modelling software for character and creature artists, digital sculptors, and concept artists. It lets you shape highly detailed 3D models the way you would work with real clay, with a brush system that can handle tens of millions of polygons in real time.

From film and games to toys, collectibles, jewellery, and product design, ZBrush is where form takes shape. Sculpt with total freedom, refine to micro detail, then hand off clean geometry to your animation, rendering, and manufacturing pipelines.

ZBrush is built for character and creature artists, digital sculptors, and concept artists, from professionals in production to artists investing in long-term skill growth. Illustrators and designers new to 3D often start on iPad and move to desktop.
What is included in a ZBrush subscription?

Every ZBrush subscription includes ZBrush on desktop, iPad, and Windows on Arm devices with premium features, rendering with Redshift, ZBrush Classroom, and Cineversity training. Maxon One adds Cinema 4D, Red Giant, Universe, and Capsules.
How does ZBrush works across different device such as desktop, iPad, and Windows on Arm?

ZBrush works between desktop, iPad, and Windows on Arm devices, so creators can maintain seamless workflow continuity across devices. We aim to deliver consistent features while optimizing the sculpting experience for each device. Check our ZBrush Feature Comparison page to see which version suits you best.
Which devices is ZBrush compatible with?
ZBrush is compatible with most of the latest versions of Windows (including Windows on Arm (WoA)), macOS, and iPadOS. For detailed information, check out our list of system requirements.
What makes ZBrush different from simplified or automated sculpting tools?

ZBrush is built around true sculptural control and artistic mastery, with the depth to take work from first idea to final production. It rewards skill and scales from exploration to production, rather than replacing the artist.
What file formats does ZBrush support?
ZBrush imports and exports standard 3D geometry formats and most industry-standard image formats for texturing, and connects to other applications through GoZ.
Which platforms does ZBrush run on?
ZBrush runs on Windows (including Windows on Arm), macOS, and iPadOS. Its processor-based engine runs well on most modern machines. A graphics tablet is strongly recommended.
What popular franchises have used ZBrush?

As the industry standard for digital sculpting, you can find works created with ZBrush across the entertainment industry. It’s been used to create characters and props in such beloved film franchises as Star Wars, Lord of the Rings, The Marvel Cinematic Universe, Transformers, Dune, and many more. In AAA video games, ZBrush has been used for Fortnite, God of War, Assassin’s Creed, and The Last of Us, among many others. ZBrush has also been used to create realistic figurines in popular tabletop games like Warhammer.

ZBrush is compatible with most of the latest versions of Windows (including Windows on Arm (WoA)), macOS, and iPadOS. ZBrush licensing is dual platform, so you can run on desktop and iPad simultaneously or switch between them at any time.

Thanks to its processor-based engine, ZBrush runs well on most modern computers regardless of their graphics cards. A graphic tablet (such as from Wacom) is strongly recommended. It will give you more control and easier interaction.
